feeds.title: Handheld Catering Blog
feeds.description: Handheld Catering is a Bay Area-based full-service event catering company that specializes in corporate event catering, wedding catering, and private events. Handheld Catering works with local farms and farmers markets, serving only fresh, wholesome foods. They make everything from scratch and never use any canned goods. They specialize in a range of dishes from handheld edibles to full-course meals.

feeds.title: Aurora Catering Blog
feeds.description: Since 2008, with quality catering and exceptional service, Aurora Catering has been the best the East Bay has to offer. Aurora Catering is owned and operated by a dedicated husband and wife team, Chef Marty and Dawn Deardorf. They create delicious dishes that combine the flavors of California, and the Mediterranean, and offer a touch of French influence. Their commitment to using fresh, seasonal ingredients ensures that every bite is bursting with flavor. Their dedicated chefs and staff ensure unforgettable culinary experiences.

feeds.title: Taste Blog
feeds.description: Driven by the passion to create unique and memorable experiences, Taste is a full-service, luxury catering company that specializes in a custom-crafted, hands-on approach to every detail. They provide unparalleled catering and event planning services for private, corporate, and wedding clients in the San Francisco Bay Area. Taste is committed to excellence in food, event design, and service. They will make your next event simply the best and leave your guests talking about it, long after.

feeds.title: OTG Blog
feeds.description: OTG began in 2010 with the simple idea of grouping Street Food creators to create an experience that allows neighbors to connect with friends, and families to reconnect with each other. Since then, their markets have become a Bay Area icon and quintessential Bay Area activity, known for its unique food and cultural experiences. After seeing people's love of street food, they decided to bring food to where people work and where they make memories with Off the Grid Catering.

feeds.title: Zerocater Blog
feeds.description: ZeroCater, renowned for its creative approach to both flexible food solutions and costume contests, stands as a beacon of innovation. The company is dedicated to curating superior workplace experiences through culinary creativity. Zerocater's commitment goes beyond mere meals; it is a testament to its passion for fostering vibrant workplace cultures by infusing creativity into both its food offerings and the spirit of workplace celebrations, exemplifying a unique and dynamic approach to corporate catering.

feeds.title: Above & Beyond Catering Blog
feeds.description: Above and Beyond Catering is one of San Francisco's top full-service catering companies. Known for their consistency, timeliness, and fresh menus, they flawlessly execute events of every shape and size. Whether you're looking for an energizing, productivity-boosting lunch break or a rewarding celebration gala, They're dedicated to creating something truly incredible. Learn more about San Francisco event planning tips, themes, and ideas, and gather inspiration from some of their past events.

feeds.title: Culinary Eye Blog
feeds.description: In 2010, Culinary Eye Catering and Events was founded with a profound love for food and a vision to craft delicious, creatively unique shared experiences. Their collective goal is to provide exceptional customer service and create memorable moments at each event. Culinary Eye Catering and Events embraces its role as a caterer, rejecting fixed menus and formats, instead believing in the fusion of creativity and service to deliver something exceptional and uniquely tailored to each client.

feeds.title: Rocketbird Blog
feeds.description: Rocketbird is born from the notion that quality ingredients, exceptionally delicious preparations, and the need for speed keep its taste buds joyfully circling the globe and delivering the finest fried chicken sandwiches on the planet to your doorstep. Its chickens are organic, vegetarian-fed, free-roamin' birds that are raised without hormones or antibiotics. Each sandwich features crispy, moist, and tender, perfectly seasoned breast meat on an artisanal potato bun with one of their house-made specialty sauces.

feeds.title: Mobydish Catering Blog » San Francisco Bay Area
feeds.description: Mobydish's mission is to build a service and technology that allows them to share special moments. They're proud to support both their customers and their local restaurant partners, to create jobs for their hardworking catering staff, and last but not least, to lead the democratization of catering for the world. Mobydish wants you to connect (or reconnect) with the people you love or with strangers who may become your new best friend… simply over a shared meal.
